description: This file is a detailed technical documentation explaining the reasoning and correctness of a rename-tracking optimization in Git's rebase and cherry-pick operations. It covers assumptions, merge mechanics, rename detection, interactions with directory renames, caching strategies, and applicable scenarios, including edge cases and exceptions. The content is aimed at developers and maintainers to understand why tracking renames on the 'upstream' side during rebases and cherry-picks is safe and beneficial, especially when certain merge options are set.
